meta.prompt: Show me a recipe card for a weeknight lemon chicken traybake: 45 minutes, Easy, serves 4 to start, with a servings control from 2 to 8 that scales the ingredient amounts. Ingredients for 4: chicken thighs 800 g, baby potatoes 600 g, lemons 2, olive oil 4 tbsp, garlic cloves 4, dried oregano 2 tsp. The ingredients as a checklist I can tick off (ticks stay when I change the servings), the four steps (Heat the oven to 220C; Toss everything in the oil, lemon and oregano; Roast 35 minutes, turning once; Rest 5 minutes and serve) and a Start cooking button.
meta.text:
ChatCard "Lemon chicken traybake" "Weeknight dinner" icon:"restaurant_rounded" status:"45 min · Easy"
  state servings=4
  state done=[]
  Row between
    Text.strong "Serves {servings}"
    Counter "Servings" "adjust" =servings min:2 max:8 step:1 label:"Servings"
  SectionLabel "Ingredients" "for {servings}"
  Checklist "Ingredients" =done items:["Chicken thighs, {servings*200} g","Baby potatoes, {servings*150} g","Lemons, {ceil(servings/2)}","Olive oil, {servings} tbsp","Garlic cloves, {servings} ","Dried oregano, {servings/2} tsp"]
  SectionLabel "Method" "4 steps"
  PlanStep "Heat the oven" "Heat the oven to 220C" index:0 current:=length(done)
  PlanStep "Toss" "Toss everything in the oil, lemon and oregano" index:1 current:=length(done)
  PlanStep "Roast" "Roast 35 minutes, turning once" index:2 current:=length(done)
  PlanStep "Rest and serve" "Rest 5 minutes and serve" index:3 last current:=length(done)
  ActionButton "Start cooking" primary icon:"play_arrow_rounded" -> emit start_cooking
